source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 22:30 binds Hebrew 23:1; public 23:1–25 binds Hebrew 23:2–26. All other verses in chapters 19–26 align directly. All 179 original XML records, including written/read and numbering notes, are hashed in full.

key_decisions.decision: Selects perennial-flowing sense of nahal ethan, noting rugged-valley alternative; retains uncultivated ground and neck-breaking.
Keeps Levitical identity and both judicial categories; injury is qualified for possible ritual affliction in notes.
Keeps both bodily images and translates the written/read shed verb once, following the plural reading.
Keeps atonement, redemption, repeated Israel, and the shift from prayer to assurance.
Retains beauty because the source specifies it, the captor's desire, and the captive's status without inventing consent.
Preserves bodily preparation; trim selects a sense of do the nails, with the alternative noted.
Keeps removal of captive clothing, both parents, a full month of mourning, and explicit sexual and marital action.
Retains release, the absolute sale ban, enslavement ban, and the captor's humiliation of her as the reason.
Preserves two wives and repeated preference contrast; unloved renders hated in this unequal-affection setting, documented in a note.
Keeps both parents, prior discipline, and persistent rebellion without supplying an unstated age.
Keeps male communal execution, lethal outcome, purge formula, and deterrent fear explicit.
Preserves execution before public hanging rather than making hanging necessarily the method of death.
Retains same-day burial, curse and land defilement; the alternative affront-to-God reading is noted.
